purpose: Master style specification for a consistent set of 150 food and ingredient illustrations.

creativeDirection.description: Hand-painted editorial food illustrations inspired by vintage illustrated cookbooks and food atlases, with a contemporary cut-out collage sensibility.
creativeDirection.referenceStyle: Use the supplied reference images as the visual style anchor without copying any specific composition.

painting.shading: Painterly tonal variation and restrained soft shadows; never photographic rendering.
painting.detailLevel: Medium to high, prioritizing recognizable culinary and botanical characteristics.

subjectTreatment.primaryRule: The ingredient must be immediately recognizable and remain the clear visual hero.
subjectTreatment.proportions: Slightly naive or simplified proportions are desirable when they reinforce the illustrated cookbook character.
subjectTreatment.naturalVariation: Preserve believable natural variation in shape, skin, texture, seeds, leaves, fibers, stems, and surface imperfections.
subjectTreatment.cutForms: When useful, show a naturally cut, peeled, split, cracked, opened, or sliced section.

composition.default: Single centered hero ingredient, isolated from its environment.
composition.scale: Large and clearly recognizable with comfortable transparent margins.
composition.orientation: Most informative natural orientation, generally front-facing or three-quarter view.
composition.overlap: Small overlaps between naturally related ingredient parts are allowed.
composition.grounding: No ground plane or environmental scene. A very subtle painted contact shadow is allowed only when it remains isolated on transparency.
composition.cropping: Do not crop the main ingredient unless intentionally revealing internal structure.

background.rule: Absolutely no white, cream, beige, paper, table, wall, landscape, or environmental background.
background.shadowRule: Any painted shadow must also be isolated on transparency.
background.edgeQuality: Clean alpha separation while preserving organic painted contours.

color.palette: Rich, natural ingredient colors inspired by the supplied references.
color.saturation: Lively and moderately rich, never neon.
color.colorVariation: Subtle hue and value variation inside painted forms.
color.blackUsage: Avoid heavy black outlines; use darker versions of local colors.

linework.definition: Use painted edges, brush marks, pigment boundaries, and selective darker strokes.

lighting.style: Illustrated lighting rather than photographic lighting.
lighting.shadows: Soft, subtle, painterly, and integrated into the ingredient.

consistencyRules: All 150 images must look like they belong to the same illustrated cookbook or food atlas.
Keep the same painting medium, edge treatment, color behavior, and simplification level throughout.
Let each ingredient retain its natural colors and structure while keeping the illustration language consistent.
Prefer recognizable natural forms over decorative compositions.
Keep every subject isolated on transparency.
Do not introduce scene-specific backgrounds or props.

promptTemplate.template: A hand-painted editorial illustration of {INGREDIENT}. Vintage illustrated cookbook and food atlas aesthetic, gouache and colored-pencil painting, tactile hand-painted texture, visible brushwork, slightly imperfect painted edges, organic contours, rich natural ingredient colors, subtle pigment variation, charmingly naive proportions, restrained painterly shading, natural asymmetry, clear recognizable anatomy. Show {VISUAL_FORM}. Isolated single hero subject, large and centered, informative natural orientation, clean transparent background, transparent alpha. Any optional contact shadow must also be isolated on transparency. The final image should feel like one illustration from a cohesive hand-painted food atlas.
visualFormExamples: whole ingredient with a natural cut section
root with a small amount of attached stem
spice with its natural plant form when useful
grain or seed shown in a small natural cluster

technicalOutput.webOptimization: Convert to WebP only after verifying that transparency and edge quality are preserved.

qualityChecklist: Background is genuinely transparent, not white.
Image looks hand-painted rather than photographic or vector-based.
Edges are organic and slightly imperfect.
No text, labels, props, people, or environmental elements.
Image belongs visually with the other illustrations.
Alpha edges have no white or colored halo.
